title: Next CVU and UrbanToronto 2026 Walking Tour July 23
summary:
UrbanToronto has partnered with the Council on Vertical Urbanism (CVU, formerly the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat) for a 2026 walking tour series examining how transit infrastructure and urban development have shaped Toronto’s growth. The Transit+Towers: Transit-Oriented Development in Toronto public tours follow Yonge Street along its corridor from Union Station to Midtown.
